props.title: One platform, different ways to work
props.intro: The same source-linked course workflow serves the people who create, operate and take technical training.

items.title: Software engineers and technical writers
items.text: Turn product documentation into structured learning content, then inspect its source links.

items.title: Instructional designers and L&D
items.text: Shape the course brief and outline, review drafts, and approve content before it reaches learners.

items.title: IT and infrastructure teams
items.text: Run a tenant-aware LMS, integrate through the REST API, and self-host the MIT-licensed core.

items.title: Technical learners
items.text: Explore working demos and courses delivered through the platform’s learner sites.

props.title: A clear path from source to learner
props.intro: ULAMS combines a headless LMS API with tenant-aware learner sites and tools for authors and developers.

items.title: Source material

props.title: How ulams compares
props.intro: ulams is built for developers and AI agents first: courses are managed through the REST API and the TypeScript SDK, with an agent-first CLI and MCP server coming. Compared with open-source and creator platforms, and with enterprise suites; our roadmap items are marked Coming.
